name: New chat api
description:
**Summary:**

1. Created a new dedicated `api/codx/junior/api/chat.py` module containing all chat-related REST endpoints as a FastAPI `APIRouter`.
2. The chat router includes endpoints for chat CRUD operations (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /chats`), cancellation (`POST /chat/cancel`), URL import (`POST /chats/from-url`), sub-tasks (`POST /chats/sub-tasks`), and Kanban board management (`GET/POST/DELETE /kanban`).
3. The `chat_cancel` endpoint supports cancellation via either `chat_id` or `token_id`, with `chat_id` taking priority and falling back to `token_id`.
4. Updated `app.py` to import the new `chat_router` and register it with the `/api` prefix via `app.include_router(chat_router, prefix="/api")`.
5. All previously inline chat endpoints were removed from `app.py`, following the existing pattern of modular routers used for other features (wiki, github, knowledge, etc.).

messages.content: Move all chat REST endpoints to api/chat
